content.title: Jesus Before the Gospels: How the Earliest Christians Remembered, Changed, and Invented Their Stories of the Savior
content.author: Bart D. Ehrman (New York: HarperOne, 2016)
content.note: Uses memory research to argue that the stories behind the Gospels were changed, and some invented, as they were retold, while the gist of Jesus' life may survive.
